quick.et: Borrowed from Middle Low German quick, from Old Saxon quik, from Proto-West Germanic *kwiku, from Proto-Germanic *kwikwaz; also a Central Franconian form. Doublet of keck, which see for more.

s: A fifth; an interval of six (kleine Quinte, diminished fifth) or seven (große Quinte, perfect fifth) semitones.
Quinte.et: Borrowed from Medieval Latin quinta. Doublet of Quinta.

Quittung.et: From Middle High German quittunge, quitunge, formed quiten + -unge, the former verb deadjectival from what is now quitt.

Quitte.et: From Middle High German quiten, from Old High German quitina, from Vulgar Latin *quidonia, from Classical Latin cotōneum, cydōnium or malum cydonium, from Ancient Greek κῠδώνῐον (kŭdṓnĭon) an elipsis from κυδώνια μῆλα, μηλοκῠδώνῐον (kudṓnia mêla, mēlokŭdṓnĭon)…

Quirl.et:
From Late Middle High German quirl, quirel, alteration of earlier Middle High German twirl, twirel, from Old High German dwiril, from Proto-West Germanic *þwiril, from Proto-Germanic *þwirilaz, related to *þweraną (“to stir”).
Cognate to English twirl; also co…

s: Wenn du mir die Hälfte zurückzahlst, sind wir quitt.
If you pay me back one half, we're even.
rid of something, having lost something
Ich hab so viel Holz im Schuppen, ich weiß gar nicht, wie ich das quitt werden soll.
I have so much wood in my shed, I don't even know how to get rid of it.
quitt.et: From Middle High German quī̆t (“released, unencumbered, free”); derived from Latin quietare. Cognate with Dutch kwijt, English quit, French quitte.

Quiche.et: Borrowed from French quiche, from Lorrainian Rhine Franconian Küeche, from Middle High German kuoche, from Old High German kuohho, from Proto-Germanic *kōkô. Doublet of Kuchen.

Quinta.et: From Latin quīnta (classis) (“fifth (class)”). Doublet of Quinte.

Zunächst wird das Quinoa unter kaltem Wasser abgespült. Danach kann es in den Reiskocher gegeben werden, optional ist auch wieder ein vorheriges Anrösten für den Geschmack möglich.
Die Quinoa bei mittlerer Hitze in ca. 10 Min. gar köcheln lassen, dabei zwischendurch umrühren. Gegarte Quinoa in das Sieb abgießen, mit kaltem Wasser abbrausen und abtropfen lassen.
